needs.proposedSignature: StaticEffect { kind: 'grant-cost-modifier'; who: 'you' | 'opponent' | 'any'; filter?: Filter; modifier: CostModifier } for the continuous form, plus Effect { op: 'grant-cost-modifier'; modifier: CostModifier; scope: 'next-spell-this-turn' } for the one-shot form.
needs.semantics: 'Nonartifact spells you cast have improvise.' (Inspiring Statuary) and '{U}, {T}: The next spell you cast this turn has improvise.' (Archway of Innovation). `{ kind: 'improvise' }` already exists as a `costModifiers` entry and cost.ts already pays it, so the family is a hook that adds a CostModifier to a spell that does not print one, plus a per-turn 'next spell you cast' scope. `cost-adjust` cannot stand in: it is a signed generic-mana adjustment, and improvise is 'each artifact you tap after mana abilities pays for {1}'.
